heard: Saturn's giant rings completely vanish every 15 years. They span tens of thousands of miles, yet disappear from view. Galileo Galilei first spotted mysterious bulges that looked like ears. When they disappeared, he admitted he was completely baffled. Astronomer Christian Huygens finally solved the mystery in 1659. He realized a flat, detached ring surrounded the planet. Spacecraft later measured the rings at just tens of meters thick. This exact alignment creates the illusion that the disk disappears.
